instructions: "Barry Lazar's quest to find fresh and authentic food has taken him to farmers' markets, strip malls, snack bars, supermarkets, and restaurants. The result of his adventures is Taste of Montreal: Tracking Down the Foods of the World - a compact guide for food lovers. Anchovies, banh mi, dolmas, kebabs, kimchi, lahmajoun, lemon grass, peppercorns, samosas, schnitzel, sourdough bread, tamales, wasabi, and zershk, are only a few of the tastes to be found in this handy book. Whether you are a native or a visitor, Taste of Montreal will introduce you to the flavours and diversity found in one of the great food capitals of the world. Book jacket."--Jacket
